A

Details of the Synthetic Dataset

The synthetic dataset we used in Figure 1 is constructed based on the statistical model proposed
in Section 3.2. In particular, we set xc,i ∈ Rd to be a random vector, where d = 30 and each
element is sampled from a uniform distribution U(0, νc ), νc ∼ U(0, 5) is different on different clients.
We assume there are total M = 100 clients, each of which has 100 data samples. Besides, we set
c,i ∼ N (0, 0.09) and generate w∗ from a distribution N (0, 1). As we shown in (13), the gradient
dissimilarity tightly depends on the scale of c,i . So we control the gradient dissimilarity via changing
the variance of c,i .
